text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Um, Cafe-san!\nThere's a strange shadow 
near the railing—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Dia-san, do not get any 
closer.\n...Yes. ...'Do not enter.'"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Gyaaah!? There's someone inside the 
mirror—!?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...He might just be trapped...\nLet us... 
make a path out from the mirror."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Cafe-senpai, um—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Excuse me for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe-senpai, there aren't any ghosts here 
anymore, right!?\nAll right, let's start 
cleaning—!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Set clean button. Start!\n—Satono 
family's state-of-the-art cleaning robot, 
launching!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh...! The dust is getting sucked 
right up!\nThen as for me... there's a 
chair, so I'll dust off the ceiling☆"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. The cleaning is coming along 
nicely.\n...Let's 'clean up'—the other 
rooms too."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Then, I shall head to the second 
floor...\n...Could everyone please clean 
the guest room?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Are you going by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"There are still many places... on the 
second floor that haven't been stepped 
into.\n...And besides—..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"(...The sight of 'Gentildonna-san' I saw 
on the bus...\nis still clinging to me... 
terribly.)"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"(If it were just a nightmare... I 
wouldn't mind.\nBut... every time I 
remember it, it weighs on my heart—)"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "(THUMP! THUMP! THUMP! THUMP!)"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, it seems a violent spirit has 
appeared.\nIt's dangerous, so... first, I 
shall—..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"All right, Dia-san!\nPlease activate the 
Satono family robot in this room too!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Leave it to me.\nSwitching... ON!!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAHHH!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...Blast-san!?\nWhat happened!?"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"The doll! Th-Th-The doll is!\nO-Over 
there!! Over there!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Clatter, clatter, clatter... Clatter, 
clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's moving...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone, run! Boo'll—Boo'll keep an eye 
on this thing! 
Go get Cafe-senpai...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAAAANNNG!!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: —Huh...? Eeeeeeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The doll's completely quieted down... 
I guess punches work on ghosts too!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I cannot say if I exorcised it as 
effectively as Cafe-san would have, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If our opponent is an "object," 
then I too possess the means to seal its 
movements.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Pass me that doll. ...I shall bind it. 
Relying entirely on Cafe-san would impede 
our progress.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Makes sense!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: What!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That takes care of the doll. 
Now then, back to cleaning—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RATTLE RATTLE RATTLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What is it this time?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Hyaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It was a poltergeist. The ceiling board 
was 
about to fall, so I smashed it to pieces!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Objects" really are no problem at all! 
Plus, if I channel 
my speed properly... even bigger things 
won't stand a chance!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to you, Gentile-senpai. Just 
as you never 
doubt your own strength—I believe in mine 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This body of mine is destined to become 
the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, my... 
Ho ho ho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Clatter... rattle rattle, 
...clatter......)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What... is that...?
